Player Screen

Not connected

Open a second window, drag it onto the TV or second monitor, and double-click it for full screen. Players only see what you reveal, and nothing is sent over the internet.

Room: click a room or corridor. Brush: paint over squares. Box: drag a rectangle. Secret door: click an “S” once the players find it, and it appears on the TV. Shift+click flashes a ring on the TV to point something out. Fog is kept on this computer; press Save to store it with a campaign.

Choose the Tokens tool above to drag them. Tokens in the fog stay hidden from players; monsters in the fight on the TV show Bloodied or Down.

What waits at the end of the road?

Forge a villain with a full stat block, scheme, lieutenants and final-battle plan, or a custom monster with lore, tactics and loot. Leave options on Random and Challenge on Auto for a creature balanced for your party.

Your current character stays put when you switch tabs. Press “Save to My characters” on its sheet to move it to the My Characters tab, where you can keep editing it.

A hero steps from the dark

Leave anything on Random, or lock in a race, class and level. You get a full 5e sheet: scores, HP, AC, saves, skills, attacks, spell slots, features, gear and a backstory hook.

Whispers from your DM

Backup

Without an account, everything you make is saved only in this browser: characters, campaigns and their maps, homebrew, custom items, your monsters, favourite spells and map fog. Clearing your browser data, or using another computer, loses it. Keep a backup file somewhere safe.

Pictures you've imported as maps aren't in the backup. Keep them with Dungeon Map → Export → Map file.

Import a character

Bring in a character from the 5e Companion App or a fillable PDF character sheet. The Forge rebuilds it with its own rules, keeping the scores, skills, gear, spells and story. Anything the Forge doesn't know becomes homebrew.

In the 5e Companion App, open the character, then use Export or Share to save its file. For a PDF, use one you can still type into.
